title: pkcs12: update the PKCS #5 definitions
description:
* Replace the tacked-on definitions in `pkcs12.asn` with a full module
  taken from the most recent spec.

* Register the HMAC OIDs.

notes.body:
added 4 commits
  • 1882e33b...d9794561 - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 7b8f041f - pkcs12: update the PKCS #5 definitions
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19207/diffs?diff_id=1285567154&start_sha=1882e33bb96d5b278d5c300fd04d6a28243b833e)

changes_data.diff:
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ set( EXT_ASN_FILE_LIST
 
 set( ASN_FILE_LIST
 	${PROTOCOL_NAME}.asn
+	PKCS5v2-1.asn
 )
 
 set( EXTRA_DIST

@@ -26,15 +26,9 @@ PrivateKeyInfo, EncryptedPrivateKeyInfo
 	FROM PKCS-8 {iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
 	pkcs(1) pkcs-8(8) modules(1) pkcs-8(1)}
 
---pkcs-9, friendlyName, localKeyId, certTypes, crlTypes
---	FROM PKCS-9 {iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
---	pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9) modules(0) pkcs-9(1) };--
-
--- A PKCS#8 IMPORT from below
-AlgorithmIdentifier, ALGORITHM-IDENTIFIER
-        FROM PKCS-5 {iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
-        pkcs(1) pkcs-5(5) modules(16) pkcs-5(1)};
-
+pkcs-9, friendlyName, localKeyId, certTypes, crlTypes
+	FROM PKCS-9 {iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
+	pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9) modules(0) pkcs-9(1) };
 
 -- Object identifiers
 
@@ -175,33 +169,4 @@ PKCS12Attribute ::= SEQUENCE {
 --	... - - Other attributes are allowed
 --}
 
---END
-
--- From RFC 2898
-PBEParameter ::= SEQUENCE {
-    salt		OCTET STRING,
-    iterationCount 	INTEGER
-}
-
-
-PBKDF2Params ::= SEQUENCE {
-    salt CHOICE {
-        specified OCTET STRING,
-	otherSource AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBKDF2-SaltSources}}--
-	},
-    iterationCount INTEGER --(1..MAX)--,
-    keyLength INTEGER (1..MAX) OPTIONAL,
-    prf AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBKDF2-PRFs}} DEFAULT algid-hmacWithSHA1-- OPTIONAL }
-
-PBES2Params ::= SEQUENCE {
-    keyDerivationFunc AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBES2-KDFs}}--,
-    encryptionScheme AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBES2-Encs}}-- }
-
-PBMAC1Params ::=  SEQUENCE {
-    keyDerivationFunc AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBMAC1-KDFs}}--,
-    messageAuthScheme AlgorithmIdentifier --{{PBMAC1-MACs}}-- }
-
-
 END
-
-

@@ -2,7 +2,6 @@
 # PKCS12 conformation file
 
 #.MODULE_IMPORT
-PKCS-5	x509af
 PKCS-7	cms
 PKCS-8	akp
 
@@ -11,6 +10,11 @@ PKCS-8	akp
 #.IMPORT ../x509if/x509if-exp.cnf
 #.IMPORT ../x509af/x509af-exp.cnf
 
+#.OMIT_ASSIGNMENT
+RC2-CBC-Parameter
+RC5-CBC-Parameters
+#.END
+
 #.EXPORTS
 
 #.REGISTER
@@ -39,16 +43,16 @@ PBEParameter		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.6" "pbeWithMD5AndRC2-CBC"
 PBEParameter		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.10" "pbeWithSHA1AndDES-CBC"
 PBEParameter		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.11" "pbeWithSHA1AndRC2-CBC"
 
-PBKDF2Params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.12" "id-PBKDF2"
-PBES2Params			B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.13" "id-PBES2"
-PBMAC1Params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.14" "id-PBMAC1"
+PBKDF2-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.12" "id-PBKDF2"
+PBES2-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.13" "id-PBES2"
+PBMAC1-params		B "1.2.840.113549.1.5.14" "id-PBMAC1"
 
 #.NO_EMIT
 
 #.TYPE_RENAME
 
 #.FIELD_RENAME
-PBKDF2Params/salt		saltChoice
+PBKDF2-params/salt		saltChoice
 
 #.PDU
 #AuthenticatedSafe

commits_data.title: pkcs12: update the PKCS #5 definitions
commits_data.message:
pkcs12: update the PKCS #5 definitions

* Replace the tacked-on definitions in pkcs12.asn with a full module
  taken from the most recent spec.

* Register the HMAC OIDs.
